item.title: WPL Auction 2026: Deepti Sharma, Amelia Kerr go past 3 crores at the first-ever mega auction - Highlights
item.description: Catch all the highlights from WPL Auction Live in New Delhi. A total of 277 players, including Deepti Sharma and Meg Lanning, went under the hammer as teams battle for 73 available slots.

item.title: Tanvi Sharma defeats Nozomi Okuhara to reach Syed Modi quarterfinals
item.description: The 16-year-old Indian shuttler fought back from a game down to beat Nozomi Okuhara in one of the standout upsets of the season.

item.title: HCL Cyclothon to debut in Bengaluru with ₹30 lakh prize purse
item.description: The inaugural Bengaluru edition of the HCL Cyclothon will feature professional, amateur and green ride categories in partnership with the Cycling Federation of India.

item.title: India edge past New Zealand to go top of Sultan Azlan Shah Cup table
item.description: Goals from Amit Rohidas, Sanjay and Selvam Karthi sealed India’s hard-fought win as they climbed to the top of the standings.

item.description: Mallika Sagar, India’s pioneering female auctioneer, has led major IPL, WPL and PKL auctions. Here’s a detailed look at her journey, career timeline and achievements.

item.title: FIH Junior Hockey World Cup 2025: India aim to end nine-year wait for the title
item.description: Placed in Pool B, India are favourites to progress, with Chile, Switzerland and Oman completing the group.
